attributes.name: Hippopotamus
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1d10 to a combat check by a character at your location. 

Discard this card to add 1d10 to a check to defeat a bane that has the Aquatic trait or a ship by a character at your location. 

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, on your combat checks, your checks to defeat banes that have the Aquatic trait, and your checks to defeat ships, add 1d10.
